sentences.text: Shri Arun Kumar Singh - advocate for the applicant.

Shri Rajeev Pandey- P.L. for the respondent/State.
 Order
After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the bail application.
During the course of hearing on bail petition, learned counsel for the applicant has referred to Annexure A/3 (statement of prosecutrix).
It is evident from Annexure A/3 that prosecutrix is mentally unsound but her statement has been recorded without assistance of any expert.
Further, it is also evident from Annexure A/3 that no relevant questions pertaining to offence under section 376 etc. of IPC have put to the prosecutrix.

Therefore, learned counsel for the State is directed to file appropriate application before the trial Court for recalling of prosecutrix and learned trial Court is also directed to properly record the statement of prosecutrix with the help of an expert and learned trial Court is expected to ensure that all relevant questions are put to the prosecutrix.
With the aforesaid observations, this bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
